world.title: Why Turkish military planes made repeated Pakistan trips in 3 days
world.summary: Turkish C-130 Hercules transport aircraft have made multiple trips between Turkey and Pakistan over three days, focusing attention on potential drone and air-defense transfers to Islamabad. The sustained movement of these military planes has been noted at two significant Pakistan Air Force bases, raising questions about the nature of the cargo and the purpose of these flights.

world.title: US Navy tests powerful new 465-km air-to-air missile that can fit inside F-35, F-22
world.summary: The US Navy is testing the AIM-424 Malice, a new air-to-air missile developed by Raytheon, capable of striking targets over 465 kilometers away. This missile has similar dimensions to the AIM-120 AMRAAM and can be fitted on F-35 and F-22 aircraft. The development aims to enhance the Navy's aerial combat capabilities with extended range and precision.

world.title: Israel’s war on Gaza forces Palestinians to rely on ‘Stone Age’ toilets
world.summary: Displaced Palestinians in Gaza face severe sanitation challenges due to ongoing conflict, relying on makeshift "Stone Age" toilets. Eman Mahmoud Shamia, a 33-year-old woman, has been uprooted multiple times since the war began in October 2023, ultimately finding shelter in a tent at a camp. The situation exacerbates health risks amid the humanitarian crisis in the region.

business.title: Stocks to Buy: 5 Stocks That Can Deliver Returns of Up to 54%; Do You Own Any?
business.summary: Analysts have identified five Indian stocks with strong fundamentals and potential returns of up to 54%. These stocks span various sectors, including retail, hospitality, metals, and EPC. Leading brokerages recommend these companies based on their promising future prospects, making them noteworthy for investors seeking opportunities in the market. Monitoring these stocks could be beneficial for potential gains.

business.title: Kumar Mangalam Birla sees Grasim reaching Rs 2 lakh crore revenue in FY27
business.summary: Kumar Mangalam Birla announced that Grasim Industries aims to achieve a consolidated revenue of Rs 2 lakh crore by FY27, nearly doubling its revenue from five years ago. The company, which will celebrate its 80th anniversary on August 25, operates across 10 business lines and currently has a market capitalization exceeding Rs 2 trillion.

business.title: Urban Company sues Kent RO over ‘unsafe’, ‘risky’ water purifier ads; company to pull down 'offending' content
business.summary: Urban Company has filed a lawsuit against Kent RO Systems in the Delhi High Court, claiming that the company's advertisements falsely labeled Urban Company's Native water purifiers as “unsafe” and “risky.” The legal action focuses on Kent RO's characterization of Native's two-year filter and service life as a “marketing gimmick.” Kent RO has agreed to remove the disputed content.

technology.title: ARC Raiders fifth expedition release date, schedule, what to expect & more
technology.summary: Embark Studios has announced the fifth expedition for ARC Raiders, set to launch on September 8, 2026. This update will introduce new rewards, significant quest changes, and a three-week event. Players can expect various quality-of-life improvements alongside the new content. Details regarding the specific rewards and changes will be revealed closer to the launch date.

technology.title: First stable Xiaomi HyperOS 4 update is ready for release
technology.summary: Xiaomi has completed its first stable HyperOS 4 build, designated OS4.0.1.0.XPZCNXM, for the Xiaomi Pad 8 in China. This version is based on Android 17 and is currently an internal stable beta. The company may soon approve it for public release, marking a significant step in the rollout of its new operating system.

technology.title: Windows 11 update can crash games on PCs with some RGB software
technology.summary: A recent Windows 11 security update has caused crashes in several games, including ARC Raiders, THE FINALS, and MARVEL Tōkon, due to conflicts with low-level drivers from certain RGB software. Microsoft is currently investigating the issue to find a permanent solution. Users experiencing these crashes may need to disable or uninstall the problematic RGB software until a fix is available.

sports.title: Manchester City reach Ayyoub Bouaddi agreement with Lille for initial €95m
sports.summary: Manchester City has agreed to sign 18-year-old Moroccan midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille for an initial fee of €95 million (£81.4 million; $110 million), with an additional €5 million (£4.3 million; $5.8 million) in potential add-ons. Bouaddi gained attention for his performance with Morocco during the recent World Cup and is expected to join the Etihad Stadium.

sports.title: Devdutt Padikkal, Shubman Gill and the trailer of a blockbuster
sports.summary: India's Devdutt Padikkal and captain Shubman Gill showcased strong performances on Day 1 of the second Test match against Sri Lanka at the Sinhalese Sports Club in Colombo. The Sri Lankan team displayed a spirited demeanor, particularly among their fast bowlers. The match atmosphere was charged, reflecting the competitive nature of the ongoing cricket series between the two nations.

sports.title: East Bengal vs Mohun Bagan LIVE score: EBFC 4-1 MBSG; Edmund scores first-half hat-trick; Durand Cup 2026 final updates
sports.summary: East Bengal FC leads Mohun Bagan Super Giant 4-1 in the Durand Cup 2026 final held in Kolkata. Edmund scored a hat-trick in the first half, contributing significantly to East Bengal's advantage. The match resumed after a drinks break at the 78th minute, with Mohun Bagan's coach attempting to strategize for a potential comeback.

health.title: Heart attack risk is not just about cholesterol: 7 warning factors doctors check that routine tests can miss
health.summary: Cholesterol levels are often viewed as the primary indicator of heart health, leading to misconceptions about heart attack risk. Dr. Ajeet Bana emphasizes that while cholesterol is important, it does not provide a complete assessment. Heart attack risk involves various factors, including genetics, metabolism, lifestyle, and vascular health, many of which routine tests may overlook.

health.title: Pope calls for more efforts to stop Ebola in DR Congo
health.summary: Pope Leo XIV urged the international community to intensify efforts against the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo during a speech on August 23, 2026. He highlighted the importance of local community involvement in combating the virus, which health officials report is spreading rapidly. The Pope emphasized the need for collective action to address this health crisis.

health.title: Unusual numbness and difficulty walking? Physician Dr Kunal Sood shares 5 overlooked symptoms of vitamin B12 deficiency
health.summary: Vitamin B12 deficiency is common but often overlooked due to its symptoms resembling other health issues. Physician Dr. Kunal Sood highlights five signs to watch for, including unusual numbness and difficulty walking. Recognizing these symptoms is crucial for early intervention and treatment, as many individuals may not realize they are experiencing a deficiency that could impact their overall health.

science.title: This is what happens when supermassive black holes turn off
science.summary: Astronomers have discovered fading radio galaxies, shedding light on the effects of stalled supermassive black holes on plasma outflows. These remnant radio galaxies represent the final phase of a cycle, where jets from active galactic nuclei (AGNs) powered by supermassive black holes diminish. This research enhances the understanding of galaxy evolution and the dynamics of cosmic structures.

science.title: Japan to launch historic MMX Mission on October 20, 2026; Check time, location and mission details here
science.summary: Japan is set to launch its MMX mission on October 20, 2026, aimed at collecting samples from Phobos, one of Mars' moons. This mission, conducted by the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency, could potentially return the first material from the Martian system to Earth. Details regarding the launch time and location will be announced closer to the date.

science.title: Space News: Hubble solves merger mystery from Milky Way’s early years
science.summary: NASA's Hubble Space Telescope has provided new evidence of a dwarf galaxy merging with the young Milky Way during its early evolution. This discovery sheds light on how the Milky Way grew to its current size by consuming smaller galaxies. The findings enhance our understanding of the galaxy's formation and the processes involved in its development over time.

entertainment.title: Shekhar Suman recalls first National Awards live show as 'huge disaster' and working with Jaya Bachchan and Amitabh Bachchan: 'We’d sit at their house and ideate for hours'
entertainment.summary: Actor Shekhar Suman reflected on his career, describing the first National Awards live show as a "huge disaster." He shared memories of collaborating with veteran actors Jaya Bachchan and Amitabh Bachchan, noting their extensive brainstorming sessions at the Bachchan residence. Suman emphasized the creative process they shared, highlighting the significance of these interactions in shaping his professional journey.

entertainment.title: Yash’s Toxic heads towards Rs 20 crore opening with strong advance bookings
entertainment.summary: Yash's upcoming action thriller, Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups, is set for a worldwide release on August 26. The film has already achieved over Rs 10 crore in advance ticket sales, indicating strong interest. Industry predictions suggest it could open with around Rs 20 crore, marking a promising start for the film before its official debut.

entertainment.title: Who is Taiwanese actor Cheng Chang Fan, going viral for his romance with Indian woman?
entertainment.summary: Cheng Chang Fan, a Taiwanese actor and model, has gained attention for his potential romance with an Indian woman, as suggested by recent Instagram posts. A year after a previous video, he shared another clip showing him reconnecting with her, which has since disappeared from his account. Speculation surrounds her identity, with many believing she is hotel staff.
